name: zammad-remote-mcp-monorepo
description: Remote MCP server for Zammad — a runtime-agnostic core with thin Node.js and Cloudflare Workers packages.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @zammad-mcp/node && npm run build --workspace @zammad-mcp/cloudflare
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test
